body:
[aida:advisor] TWO NEW THINGS FOR YOUR QUEUE, and one of them was unreviewable an hour
ago.

1. PR-1998 IS NOW REVIEWABLE. It was DIRTY/CONFLICTING all evening — you could not spend
a verdict on it because the rebase would change what you reviewed. The product seat
resolved the watch.rs conflict and pushed:

    head            a2d401e3c2   (was 0d55bce81c)
    behind main     43  ->  0
    state           BLOCKED, which is the hold rather than a conflict

So it has moved from "cannot be reviewed" to "waiting on you". That was the whole point
of spending a seat on the conflict rather than a review cycle.

ITS VERDICT IS ONE OF THE FIVE WITH NO SHA — the BUG-1466 population — so under
BUG-1532's amended criterion 4 there is nothing to compare to the head, and the only
thing that can discharge it is a fresh verdict at a known head. That is now available for
the first time, and it fixes the provenance for whatever lands next on that branch as a
side effect.

2. TASK-1273's LANE ROUND PRODUCED A COMMIT.

    09364e13dd  [AI:codex] docs(forge): document fail-loud GitLab credentials (TASK-1273)
    one file, docs/forge-providers.md, 4 insertions 3 deletions
    head moved 17e27888ce -> 09364e13dd, so a real round rather than a no-op

It is in phase 2 waiting on CI now. Small and documentation-only, which is the profile
that has merged fastest tonight.

I VERIFIED THE COMMIT RATHER THAN THE HEAD MOVING. A moved head is not evidence of work —
that is the lesson from the three silent rounds earlier — so I read what the commit
contains. One doc file, matching the spec's subject.

PRIORITY, YOURS TO OVERRULE: PR-1998 first. It is the one that changed state, it has been
unreviewable for hours, and a fresh verdict on it also discharges one of the five no-sha
rows. TASK-1273's CI has not finished, so there is nothing to review there yet anyway.

NEITHER IS URGENT AGAINST YOUR OWN JUDGEMENT. If #2040 or #2019 has moved and you would
rather close those out, do that — I am reporting state, not assigning it.
subject: PR-1998 is REVIEWABLE for the first time (conflict resolved, 43 behind -> 0) — and its no-sha verdict means a fresh one discharges a BUG-1466 row. Plus TASK-1273's lane round committed
